- US-only deep dive: 16:00–17:00 UTC (works for US late morning, EU late afternoon)

- Session 1 (APAC-friendly / EU early): 08:00–09:00 UTC on Tuesday, Mar 10 — (Tokyo ~17:00, Berlin ~09:00) — 45 min demo + 15 min Q&A
- Session 2 (US deep dive): 16:00–17:15 UTC on Wednesday, Mar 11 — (New York ~11:00, London ~16:00) — 60 min demo + 15 min focused integration Q&A

Why two sessions: avoids forcing an awkward hour on any region and lets our solutions engineer tailor the deep-dive content for US platform/integration questions. Ethan will lead the APAC/EU session; Jasmine will run the US deep dive.

I've attached a short mutual action plan and a CSV of tentative calendar slots so Elena can pick final times and attendee lists.
